query:
with ins as (
  insert into public.registration_tokens (tenant_id, subscriber_id, target_role, token_hash, expires_at)
  values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::public.user_role, $4, now() + make_interval(hours => $5::int))
  returning id
)
insert into public.event_log (system_module, event_type, event_source, payload)
select 'registration', 'token_issued', 'node-red',
       jsonb_build_object('token_id', id, 'tenant_id', $1::uuid, 'target_role', $3::public.user_role, 'ttl_hours', $5::int)
from ins
returning payload->>'token_id' as token_id;
